Greek property prices are still rising in 2026, though the market has shifted from a post-pandemic surge to a slower, more selective phase of growth.[[1]](https://nest-land.com/greece-real-estate-market-2026-trends-prices-forecast/)

- **National Averages:** The Bank of Greece reports that residential apartment prices rose **5.5% to 5.7%** year-on-year through the first half of 2026, continuing to sit above their 2008 pre-crisis peak. Actual recorded median transaction prices average around **€1,479/m²** nationwide (with typical 68 m² apartments selling for roughly €95,000), while platform asking prices are higher.[[1]](https://dkg-development.com/business-in-greece/greece-property-market-2026-analysis)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/delfipropertiesgr/posts/greek-property-prices-are-still-climbing-in-2026-just-not-the-way-the-headlines-/1875679013868996/)[[3]](https://nest-land.com/greece-real-estate-market-2026-trends-prices-forecast/)
- **Athens & South Suburbs:** Prices in central Athens rose about **5.0%** year-on-year, with average asking prices around **€1,838/m² to €2,400/m²** . Prime areas like Athens South reach **€4,167–€4,231/m²** , while luxury stretches of the [Athens Riviera](https://www.vonpollgreece.com/en/blog/1353/what-shapes-greece-real-estate-prices-in-2026) can exceed **€10,000/m²** . Athens North averages around **€3,500/m²**.[[1]](https://www.globalpropertyguide.com/europe/greece/price-history)[[2]](https://nest-land.com/greece-real-estate-market-2026-trends-prices-forecast/)[[3]](https://dkg-development.com/business-in-greece/greece-property-market-2026-analysis)[[4]](https://elxis.com/greece-vs-europe-where-to-buy-a-home-in-2026)[[5]](https://www.spitogatos.gr/en/property-index)[[6]](https://www.vonpollgreece.com/en/blog/1353/what-shapes-greece-real-estate-prices-in-2026)
- **Thessaloniki:** Apartment prices in Thessaloniki grew by approximately **6.4% to 7.7%** year-on-year, with average asking or quotation prices sitting near **€2,384–€2,667/m²**.[[1]](https://www.indomio.gr/en/agora-akiniton/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/delfipropertiesgr/posts/greek-property-prices-are-still-climbing-in-2026-just-not-the-way-the-headlines-/1875679013868996/)[[3]](https://nest-land.com/greece-real-estate-market-2026-trends-prices-forecast/)[[4]](https://www.globalpropertyguide.com/europe/greece/price-history)
- **Regions & Mainland:** Growth is currently outpacing central Athens in select regional markets and secondary cities. The most affordable mainland regions (such as Kozani or Pella) trade closer to **€575/m²**.[[1]](https://dkg-development.com/business-in-greece/greece-property-market-2026-analysis)[[2]](https://nest-land.com/greece-real-estate-market-2026-trends-prices-forecast/)
- **Islands & Coastal Areas:** Island and prime coastal markets (such as Crete, Corfu, and the Cyclades) vary widely by micro-location. Luxury developments in places like Elounda or parts of the Cyclades command **€7,700–€11,700/m²** , while smaller or less-tourist-heavy islands offer lower entry points.[[1]](https://www.vonpollgreece.com/en/blog/1353/what-shapes-greece-real-estate-prices-in-2026)[[2]](https://www.youroverseashome.com/greece/articles/greek-islands-with-cheaper-property-prices/)
- **Key Market Pressures:** Growth is cooling due to stretched local affordability, a short-term rental (Airbnb) freeze in central Athens and Thessaloniki zones, and upcoming/proposed tax and transfer rule adjustments for non-EU buyers.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/delfipropertiesgr/posts/greek-property-prices-are-still-climbing-in-2026-just-not-the-way-the-headlines-/1875679013868996/)[[2]](https://nest-land.com/greece-real-estate-market-2026-trends-prices-forecast/)

You can browse live regional data and listing breakdowns via the [Spitogatos Property Index](https://www.spitogatos.gr/en/property-index) or view transaction averages through [Indomio Greece](https://www.indomio.gr/en/agora-akiniton/).[[1]](https://www.indomio.gr/en/agora-akiniton/)[[2]](https://www.spitogatos.gr/en/property-index)If you have a specific target area in mind, let me know:
